page.title: Content
page.description: Upstreams, the entries and fields every device's config is built from, and publishing.

json.objectRequired: An entry must be a JSON object

upstreams.description: Configs we import from. The primary one supplies the top-level fields; each line of a collection (urls) becomes an upstream of its own and syncs with it.
upstreams.name: Name
upstreams.synced: Synced: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{removed}} removed, {{mirrored}} files mirrored. Publish to make it live.
upstreams.assetsFailed: {{count}} file(s) could not be mirrored; previous copies are kept.
upstreams.deleteDescription: Every entry imported from "{{name}}" is removed with it.

entries.modifiedHint: Edited here: upstream changes are recorded but not applied until you revert.
entries.trashHint: Upstream entries deleted here; syncs do not add them back
entries.bulkDeleteHint: Local entries are removed for good; upstream ones go to the recycle bin, where syncs leave them and you can restore them.
entries.deleteLocalHint: A local entry is removed for good.
entries.deleteUpstreamHint: It goes to the recycle bin: syncs do not add it back, and it can be restored.
entries.uploadHint: Upload a jar, json… and use the path (copied) in jar, ext, api and similar fields.

templateHint.cmsJson: A MacCMS JSON API (usually ending in /api.php/provide/vod/); the app calls it directly, no spider needed.
templateHint.cmsXml: A MacCMS XML API (/api.php/provide/vod/at/xml/); the app calls it directly.
templateHint.jar: api is csp_<ClassName>, jar the path of the spider jar (upload it below), ext what the spider is given.

globals.description: Top-level fields such as spider, wallpaper and flags. Values are JSON.
globals.invalidKey: Choose a field name that is not one of the entry lists

publishes.description: Clients read the live version. Publishing snapshots the current entries and fields.

health.unexempt: Let the check switch it off again
health.hint: Down entries are switched off by the scheduled check. Switching one back on forces it on: the check keeps reporting but no longer switches it off.
